approach.statement_refutation: StatementRefutation.lean: the D7 statement-level existence statements are refuted as formalized. Counterexample spacetime on PUnit: volume = Dirac, laplacian = LinearMap.id, timeDerivative = 0, dist = 0, dim = 0, certified IsClosedRiemannianManifold (the predicate does not mention the operators). General schema: any nonempty HeatSpacetime with laplacian = id and timeDerivative = 0 admits no IsHeatKernel/IsHeatKernelV1 kernel (solves forces K = 0 vs positive). Consequence: D7-HEAT-KERNEL-EXISTENCE cannot be closed by proving the statement as written; the statement must be repaired by pinning the operators to geometric ones (data-level HeatKernelDataV1 is the honest target).

approach.geometric_repair: GeometricRepair.lean: (1) AnnihilatesConstants S := (S.laplacian 1 = 0) — the one geometric necessary condition expressible over the schematic interface and verifiable for the honest flat operator (flatHeatSpacetime_laplacian_one); it excludes the refuting spacetime (laplacian = id) and is strictly stronger than IsClosedRiemannianManifold; models: punitDiracSpacetime (zero operators, Dirac volume) and adversarialTimeDerivativeSpacetime. The stronger classical conditions (self-adjointness, dissipativity) are deliberately NOT fields: their all-functions Bochner-integral forms are false for the honest packaged flat Laplacian (informal counterexample u = 1, v = log cosh on ℝ: ∫1·Δv = [tanh] = 2 ≠ 0 = ∫Δ1·v), and their C_c/C² forms need a smooth normed structure the interface does not carry. (2) Second statement-level refutation: adversarialTimeDerivativeSpacetime (volume = Dirac, Δ = 0, ∂_t = id, dist = 0, dim = 0) satisfies both predicates and admits no IsHeatKernelV1 witness; not_forall_annihilatesConstants_implies_exists_snapshot_kernel. (3) Time-rescaling: flatSnapshotSpacetime (∂_t := Δ) makes the solves field vacuous; flatKernelRescaled n c (x,y,t) ↦ flatKernel n x y (c·t) satisfies IsHeatKernelV1 for every c > 0 but for c = 2 fails the PDE at x = y = 0, t = 1 (chain rule gives 2·ΔK(·,0,2) vs the required ΔK(·,0,2), and ΔK(0,0,2) = K(0,0,2)·(-n/4) ≠ 0); hence not_forall_isHeatKernelV1_imp_isHeatKernelPDE and snapshot_pde_predicates_incomparable (with the converse from PDERepair). (4) HeatKernelExistenceStatementPDE and HeatKernelDataExistenceStatement (def … : Prop, stated not proved), heatKernelDataExistenceStatement_implies_pde, and model inhabitants including heatKernelExistenceStatementPDE_conclusion_adversarial / heatKernelDataExistenceStatement_conclusion_adversarial.

approach.conjugate_heat_bridge: ConjugateHeatBridge.lean (eighth invocation): the D7 conjugate-heat interface (ConjugateHeatSpacetime with volume, laplacian, scalarMul, backwardTimeDerivative) on the corrected domain. (1) Refutation: IsRiemannianConjugateHeatSpacetime constrains only the volume, so the two-point datum with laplacian = LinearMap.id, scalarMul = 0, backwardTimeDerivative = 0 satisfies it and □* u = -u forces K = 0 against positivity; general schema with injective Laplacian. (2) Repair: IsConjugateHeatKernelPDE (v2) = genuine HasDerivAt conjugate heat equation ∂_t K(x,y,t) = -Δ_x K(·,y,t)(x) + R(x)K(x,y,t) on t < t0, positivity/normalization/Dirac on a D12 admissible class. (3) Transport: any HeatKernelDataV1 datum maps to it by the time reversal t ↦ t0 - t (chain rule, normalization through symmetry, terminal Dirac limit through tendsto_const_sub_nhdsLT). (4) Flat model: the time-reversed D10 kernel inhabits it in every dimension on the integrable and C_c classes, is symmetric, has unit mass, conserves mass, satisfies Chapman-Kolmogorov, and refutes the legacy snapshot predicate in positive dimension (so the predicates are not equivalent). (5) Positive counterpart: FlatConjugateCorrectedDomainExistence is proved. (6) D7 consumer: Poincare.D7.ConjugateHeat.Status records the refutation, the corrected-domain statement and its proof, and the structural laws at the D7 level.
approach.finite_pinned_operator: Ninth invocation. FiniteSpaceHeat.lean. The schematic interface is repaired in the finite setting by pinning the generator: FiniteHeatOperator = {L : Matrix X X ℝ // Lᵀ = L ∧ (∀ x, ∑ y, L x y = 0) ∧ (∀ x y, x ≠ y → 0 < L x y)}. Kernel K x y t = (exp (t • L)) x y for t > 0, clipped to 0 at t ≤ 0. Positivity: shift c = ∑ x |L x x| + 1 makes M = L + c • 1 entrywise positive; exp (t • L) = exp (-(t c)) • exp (t • M) (Matrix.exp_add_of_commute + Matrix.exp_diagonal for the scalar identity exponential); entries of exp (t • M) are nonnegative tsums and strictly positive by comparison with the n = 1 term (Summable.le_tsum). Row sums via the HasSum of the exponential series pushed through the CLM A ↦ A *ᵥ 1 (Matrix.expSeries_hasSum_exp, L *ᵥ 1 = 0, hasSum_single, HasSum.unique); column sums by symmetry. Chapman-Kolmogorov from Matrix.exp_add_of_commute. blockers.statement_level_finding: The D7 predicate-level existence statements are not merely unproved: they are FALSE as formalized. IsClosedRiemannianManifold does not constrain laplacian/timeDerivative, and the one-point counterexample (laplacian = id, timeDerivative = 0) makes the shared solves field force K = 0 at every point, contradicting strict positivity.
